mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale_returns (after_sale_id, return_way, return_time_slot, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{afterSaleId}, #{returnWay}, #{returnTimeSlot}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, after_sale_id, return_way, return_time_slot, return_courier, return_tracking_number, pickup_at, pickup_no, return_at, review_at, rejected_at, refund_at, refunded_at, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM after_sale_returns WHERE after_sale_id = #{afterSaleId} AND is_deleted = 0
